name: subagent-router
description: Picks a model for each subagent from its task: small models for lookups, big models for hard work, while the main thread keeps its own model

small.title: Small tasks
small.description: Model for search, reading, listing, summaries and mechanical edits. An alias (haiku) or a full model id.

medium.title: Medium tasks
medium.description: Model for a well-scoped change, tests or a code review.

large.title: Large tasks
large.description: Model for design, hard debugging, security review or a change that needs judgment across many files.

classifier.title: Classifier
classifier.description: Model that reads the task and picks small, medium or large. One short call for each subagent.

types.title: Routed agent types
types.description: Subagent types the router decides for, comma-separated. Other types keep the model their own definition sets.
